dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.speech.jay: Mine! I found it first, it is mine!
Don't kill it, don't kill it! Big boss wants it alive!
Ooh, a sleepy one. Get the rope, quick quick!
Nobody stab it! A live one is worth more shinies!
It is not dead! Good, good. We are taking it home.
Tie it tight! Tighter! It bites, I know it bites.
Night night, pretty. You are going to work for us now.
One bonk for sleeping. Heh. Carry it, carry it!
Got it! I got it! The king is going to give me the biggest share!
Hush now. You are ours. Don't cry, the chains are only a little rusty.
